title: Tuberculosis
text: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by bacteria that mainly affects the lungs. It spreads from person to person through the air.

title: High Blood Pressure
text: High blood pressure is a common condition where the force of blood against artery walls is too high. It can increase the risk of heart disease and stroke.

title: Diabetes Mellitus
text: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels caused by problems with insulin production or action.

title: Influenza
text: Influenza is a respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses. Symptoms may include fever, cough, sore throat, and fatigue.

title: Heart Disease
text: Heart disease refers to several conditions affecting the heart. Coronary artery disease is one of the most common forms.
